meta.title: Recognise a BOQ-based PR
gaps: Directly assert that the selected PR's Item Type is BOQ
Assert that a BOQ PR can only be purchased alone, one BOQ PR at a time
Assert the BOQ's sections and items as structured PR data
Directly assert that opening the PR creates a BOQ project
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly assert that the selected PR's Item Type is BOQ; Assert that a BOQ PR can only be purchased alone, one BOQ PR at a time; Assert the BOQ's sections and items as structured PR data; Directly assert that opening the PR creates a BOQ project

steps.note: Enable BOQ-based events as required by the test configuration.
Open the Purchase Requisitions area, the required starting screen for a PR-based test.
Ensure the PR list is on the Open tab where the required PR can be selected.

args.goal: find an open purchase requisition whose Item Type is BOQ, open it, and inspect that it shows the BOQ sections and items; stop on the BOQ PR details screen

steps.note: No catalog step can identify a PR by Item Type or inspect its BOQ sections and items, so perform the buyer-side inspection in the current session.
Assert that the resulting screen visibly identifies the requisition or its content as BOQ.
